GD-C-01.title: C# objects and collections — individual exercise
requirements: Create a C# ScoreCounter class and two separate instances, both starting at zero. Add nonnegative integer points and display their values in one local Unity scene; reject negative inputs.
Keep the work limited to this fixture and the named behavior. Record inputs, outputs and a short explanation; no full application is required.
acceptanceCriteria: Instances do not share score accidentally; negative points are rejected without changing either score.
GD-C-01.setup: Use the linked course setup and its supplied references. Work locally with fictional or self-created data. No paid service, public deployment or hardware purchase is required.
